name: Craftco
old_description: Started as a job shop in 1981 by founders Billy and Marva Craft, Craftco has grown to become a nationwide leader in welding, manufacturing, materials handling, assembly and processing. We operate out of our 25,000-square-foot facility right here in Sheridan, Wyoming, and we take pride in building relationships and solving problems through customer service. Read about our services, capabilities, and even some of the products we build.
about:
Craftco began in 1981 as a one-person welding shop in Sheridan, Wyoming, founded by Billy and Marva Craft. Operating initially from a garage in the foothills of the Bighorn Mountains, the business grew rapidly through the 1980s and moved to its current 25,000-square-foot facility in 1993, with subsequent expansions adding machining capabilities.

Today the company provides full-service manufacturing under one roof: welding and fabrication (including heavy plate forming, waterjet cutting, and certified structural welding), precision CNC machining (turning and milling up to 22-inch diameter), materials processing (raw stock management, precision sawing), coating and assembly (multi-layer protective coatings, sub-assembly, turnkey builds), and engineering and design (DFM analysis). The facility houses equipment such as a Marvel computerized band saw, a Flow water jet, a Mazak 7K laser cutter, and a Diamond BH 8525 press brake.

Craftco serves customers nationwide across mining, firearms manufacturing, fossil fuel extraction, robotics, commercial and residential construction, structural building, and oil and gas. Notable projects include wear liner plates for the Antofagasta mine in Chile (2012) and ongoing partnerships with large mining corporations and firearm manufacturers. The company also supports supply chain stability through blanket order and open PO programs.

The founders’ original focus on problem-solving remains central: Craftco positions itself as a manufacturing partner that combines engineering, machining, fabrication, and assembly to solve complex challenges. Its stated mission emphasizes long-term partnerships, quality, value, and professionalism, guided by a “Code of the West” ethos that stresses integrity, safety, and keeping promises.
